The game printed this runtime error:

```
SCRIPT ERROR: Invalid call. Nonexistent function 'set_meta' in base 'Nil'.
   at: spawn_wave (res://main.gd:13)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] spawn_wave (res://main.gd:13)
       [1] _ready (res://main.gd:8)
```

The error is in `res://main.gd` at line 13, in `spawn_wave()`: `boss.set_meta("hp", 100)`. The `enemies` dictionary is empty, so `enemies.get("boss")` on line 12 returns `null`. Calling `set_meta` on `null` then fails. `_ready()` triggers this on line 8, after a 1-second timer.

The debugger paused at that error, so I stopped the game afterward. I didn't change any files.
